clauses.text: Settings, Keyboard (administrators) shows Function keys mode, ISO layout, Option/Command swap, key repeat, detected controls with their test buttons, the last special keys and the table of recognised keys

steps.do: Open Settings, Keyboard as an administrator and read the page from top to bottom.
steps.expect: Each named row is there: Function keys mode, ISO layout, Option/Command swap, key repeat delay and rate, the detected controls with Test screen, Test keyboard light and Test sound, the last special keys and the table of recognised keys.

steps.do: Sign out, sign in again and open the same page.
steps.expect: The choices made earlier are still set.

clauses.text: the key repeat delay and rate change how fast a held key repeats

steps.do: Change the repeat delay to a shorter value, then hold a letter key in a text field.
steps.expect: The letter repeats after the shorter delay. Change the rate and hold the key again: the repeat speed changes.

clauses.text: Function keys mode and Option/Command swap change what the Apple keyboard sends

steps.do: On an Apple keyboard, set Function keys mode to F-keys first, press F1 in a text field, then set it to media keys first and press F1 again.
steps.expect: With F-keys first F1 is typed; with media keys first the key sends its media action. Option/Command swap, when changed, swaps the two keys in a text field.
